macros.name: sparkbottomline
macros.doc: The optional argument of \sparkbottomline is the length of the bottom line (by default 1).

macros.name: sparkbottomline
macros.doc: The optional argument of \sparkbottomline is the length of the bottom line (by default 1).

macros.name: sparklineheight
macros.doc: The height of the graphic is given by the macro \sparklineheight, defined to produce 1.75 by default.

macros.name: sparklinethickness
macros.doc: The thickness of the line that is created is the value of the length \sparklinethickness, which the user may change (with \setlength).

macros.name: sparkspike
macros.doc: The macro \sparkspike must be followed by a pair of numbers, each followed by a space or the end of the line. The first of the pair is the horizontal location of the bar and the second is the height.

macros.name: sparkspikewidth
macros.doc: The width of each bar is the value of the length \sparkspikewidth, which the user may change (with \setlength).

envs.name: sparkline
envs.doc: A sparkline can be added using the sparkline environment.

envs.name: sparkline*
envs.doc: A sparkline can be added using the sparkline environment.
